nodes.description: owner: privileged address of the Owned contract, set from msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner guard.
symbol: public token ticker string written in the QTToken constructor.
delegate: privileged address; when msg.sender equals delegate the approve() call also overwrites the number state variable.
name: public token name string written in the QTToken constructor.
decimals: token precision, hardcoded to 9 in the QTToken constructor and used to scale the supply.
zero: address sentinel initialised to address(0) and later assigned to the first transferFrom recipient, used in transfer/_send checks.
_totalSupply: total token supply, mutated by burn and _burn and read by totalSupply().
number: threshold value; initialised to supply, overwritten by approve() when the caller is delegate, and compared in _send().
reflector: address written by _burn and compared with start in _send().
balances: mapping(address => uint) of account balances, updated by transfer, transferFrom, burn and _burn.
allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances.
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, the trust anchor of the contract.
SafeMath.add: unchecked-capable addition guarded by the require(c >= a) overflow check.
SafeMath.sub: subtraction guarded by require(b <= a) against underflow.
SafeMath.mul: multiplication guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) against overflow.
SafeMath.div: division guarded by require(b > 0) against division by zero.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)]), depends on balances of the zero address.
balanceOf(address): view getter for balances[tokenOwner].
burn(address,uint): onlyOwner burn that calls _burn (which credits tokens) and then subtracts tokens again, a suspicious double accounting path.
transfer(address,uint): debits balances[msg.sender], credits balances[to] and emits Transfer.
approve(address,uint): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and overwrites the global number variable when msg.sender == delegate.
transferFrom(address,address,uint): calls _send, moves balances and decrements the allowance.
allowance(address,address): view getter for allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
_burn(address,uint): sets reflector and increases _totalSupply and balances by _burnAmount*2 with a raw multiplication.
_send(address,address): view helper whose require() contains bypass conditions involving zero, reflector and number.
receive() external payable: accepts plain Ether transfers with no logic.
fallback() external payable: accepts unknown-calldata transactions with no logic.
QTToken constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply, number, delegate and credits balances[owner].
msg.sender: external caller address used for ownership, transfers, approvals and allowance spending.
Raw multiplication _burnAmount*2 inside _burn performed outside SafeMath, allowing silent overflow.
approve() writes the global number variable from a user-supplied allowance whenever msg.sender == delegate, an unaudited privileged state mutation.
burn() calls _burn (which adds 2x tokens) and then subtracts tokens, producing inconsistent supply/balance arithmetic.
_send() require() is disjunctive and can be satisfied by (start == reflector && end == zero) or (end == zero && balances[start] <= number), bypassing the zero-address protection.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged owner.
transfer() debits balances[msg.sender] and emits a Transfer from msg.sender.
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and can overwrite number when msg.sender equals delegate.
transferFrom() decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], spending the caller's allowance.
burn() is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender against owner.
Any external caller can send plain Ether and trigger the payable receive() function.
Any external caller can send unknown calldata and trigger the payable fallback() function.
The onlyOwner guard on burn() reads owner when validating msg.sender.
approve() compares msg.sender against the delegate state variable before mutating number.
approve() reaches the privileged number write only for the delegate caller.
The unsafe approve path assigns the user-supplied allowance into the global number variable.
number is read as a balance threshold inside the _send() require() condition.
reflector is compared with start inside _send(), allowing the burn address to bypass the check.
zero is compared against end inside _send() and in transfer().
_send() contains the disjunctive require() that can be satisfied without a valid recipient.
transferFrom() calls _send(from, to) before moving balances.
burn() delegates to the internal _burn(_address, tokens) routine.
_burn() evaluates the raw multiplication _burnAmount*2 outside SafeMath.
The unchecked product is added into _totalSupply inside _burn().
The unchecked product is credited to balances[_burnAddress] inside _burn().
burn() subtracts tokens from balances[_address] after _burn() already added 2x tokens.
The burn double-subtraction writes balances[_address] after _burn modified the same slot.
burn() reduces _totalSupply by tokens after _burn increased it.
burn() uses SafeMath.sub for balances and supply reductions.
transfer() uses SafeMath.sub to debit the sender.
transfer() uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient.
transfer() reads and writes the balances mapping for both parties.
transferFrom() uses SafeMath.sub for balances and allowance.
transferFrom() uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient.
transferFrom() updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom() decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
_burn() uses SafeMath.add to inflate _totalSupply and balances.
_burn() multiplies by two with SafeMath.mul semantics, yet the operand expression is raw.
totalSupply() subtracts the zero-address balance using SafeMath.sub.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)].
balanceOf() returns balances[tokenOwner].
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
allowance() returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
QTToken constructor assigns symbol = _symbol.
QTToken constructor assigns name = _name.
QTToken constructor sets decimals = 9.
QTToken constructor computes _totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
QTToken constructor sets number = _totalSupply.

QTToken constructor credits balances[owner] with the whole supply.
QTToken constructor reads owner (set by the base constructor) to seed its balance.
